calls.statement:
SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS d, sum(closing_units) AS units, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-23' AND DATE '2026-10-11'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT cp.category, cp.subcategory IS NULL AS nosub, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT cs.store_id) AS stores, count(DISTINCT cp.sku) AS skus, sum(fs.closing_units) AS units,
 sum(CASE WHEN fs.closing_units<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg, min(cs.store_id) AS minstore, max(cs.store_id) AS maxstore, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id>=900 THEN fs.closing_units ELSE 0 END) AS units900
FROM fact_stock_week fs
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE fs.week_ending_date=DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-24' AS x, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), max(etl_loaded_at), sum(quantity) q
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1

WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-09-27' AS week_ending),
closing AS (
  SELECT cp.category, SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units
  FROM fact_stock_week fs
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  CROSS JOIN params
  WHERE fs.week_ending_date = params.week_ending AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1),
sold AS (
  SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold_4w
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  CROSS JOIN params
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN params.week_ending - 34 AND params.week_ending - 7
    AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT c.category, c.closing_units, ROUND(s.units_sold_4w / 4.0, 1) AS avg_weekly_units_sold, ROUND(c.closing_units / (s.units_sold_4w / 4.0), 1) AS weeks_of_cover, s.units_sold_4w
FROM closing c LEFT JOIN sold s USING (category) ORDER BY c.category
